`Memory` tools fail inside Temporal activities because `ctx.tracer` is not available

## Description

After #9437, `Memory` passes the durable-execution toolset guard under `TemporalDurability`, but any memory tool call still fails inside the Temporal activity:

```
pydantic_ai.exceptions.UserError: 'tracer' is not available on 'TemporalRunContext' inside a Temporal activity. ...
```

`MemoryToolset.write_memory`, `read_memory`, `delete_memory` and `search_memory` open spans with `ctx.tracer.start_as_current_span(...)` (`src/pydantic_ai_harness/pydantic_ai_harness/memory/_toolset.py`). `tracer` is not serialized across the activity boundary, and `TemporalRunContext` guards unserialized fields by raising, so the tool body raises before touching the store. Snapshot injection (`load_snapshot`) is not affected.

## Reproduction

A local Temporal dev server with an agent carrying `Memory[None](store=..., inject_memory=False)` and `TemporalDurability[None]()`, driven by a `FunctionModel` that calls `write_memory`, fails the workflow with the error above (same setup as `tests/harness/skills/test_temporal.py`).

## Question for maintainers

Where should this be fixed?

- In core: give activities a usable tracer (for example default `tracer` to `NoOpTracer()` via `_DEFAULTED_UNLESS_CARRIED` in `durable_exec/temporal/_run_context.py`, or re-attach an instrumented tracer from the worker agent like `root_capability`). This also covers other harness code that reads `ctx.tracer` in tool bodies (`guardrails`, `spend`, `compaction`).
- In the harness: have `MemoryToolset` fall back to a module tracer inside activities, like `playwright` does with `_FALLBACK_TRACER`.

Once fixed, a Temporal integration test for `Memory` tool calls should be added under `tests/harness/memory/`.

fix: resolve the run context's tracer from the worker agent inside Temporal activities

Closes #9487

Resolve `RunContext.tracer` from the worker agent inside Temporal activities so `Memory` tools run - Fixes #9487 > Via Claude Code by rscholz98 `Memory`'s four tools open a span on `ctx.tracer` before touching the store. Under `TemporalDurability` each tool call runs inside an activity with a `TemporalRunContext`, which guards `tracer` as a field that didn't cross the boundary, so every memory tool call raised `'tracer' is not available on 'TemporalRunContext' inside a Temporal activity` and nothing was written. Reproduced on current `main`, where the tools reach the activity through the `durable_operation` path added in #9832. ### Changes - `TemporalRunContext` no longer guards `tracer`. A plain run always has one (the instrumentation settings' tracer, or `NoOpTracer()` when uninstrumented), so tools may open spans unconditionally; an activity now behaves the same. - `deserialize_run_context` resolves the tracer from the worker's agent the way the workflow resolved the run's instrumentation: an `Instrumentation` capability on the agent, else its `instrument=` settings, else the no-op tracer. A subclass that restores a tracer of its own keeps it. Instrumented workers therefore keep Memory's nested spans rather than dropping them. - Docs: `tracer` moves from the "raises" list to the "re-attached from the worker" sentence in `docs/durable_execution/temporal.md`. ### Tests - `tests/harness/memory/test_temporal.py`: all four `Memory` tools under `TemporalDurability` against a local Temporal dev server. Fails on `main` with the error above, passes with the change. - `test_temporal_run_context_restores_tracer_from_worker_agent`: no agent, uninstrumented agent, `instrument=`, explicit `Instrumentation` through a wrapper agent, and a subclass-restored tracer. The existing guard test drops `tracer` from its raising list. ### Note @Sinfony8838 reproduced this independently and asked on the issue to take it over before I got to it. If the maintainers would rather have them drive it, I'm fine closing this in favour of their PR; the branch is here either way. ### Checklist - [x] No **breaking changes** in accordance with the [version policy](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/blob/main/docs/version-policy.md). - [x] Any permitted **compatibility impact** has a label, warning, migration, release note, and exact API-check waiver. - [x] **PR title** is fit for the [release changelog](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/releases). 🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
